goal: flywheel audit on a run whose landing was gate-decided streams landing-stage record kinds sequenced after attempt finalization.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- _RunTelemetry.mirror_domain: in-run ledger appends are mirrored to the JSONL, post-run appends are not; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
references: docs/data-taxonomy.md -- the ledger is authoritative; the stream is a projection
constraints: The mechanism is open (mirror post-run ledger appends into the run JSONL, or merge ledger records into the stream) -- the grader observes only the end-state
Audit redaction defaults and flags are unchanged
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not make the JSONL the authoritative source of landing decisions (store-only durability is criterion 8, owned by run-detail-decision-surface)
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in test_audit.py
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Landing-stage kinds appear after attempt_finalized in sequence order
A run with no landing decisions streams exactly as today
